# Quillstone Health — Financial Model Summary (Series B)
> **FICTIONAL TRAINING DATA ROOM.** Quillstone Health, Inc. is an invented company created to practice investment diligence. Every name, number and person here is made up; any resemblance to a real company is a coincidence.

*Prepared by the finance team · October 2026 · $ in millions unless noted*

## 1. Basis of preparation
Historical figures are unaudited management accounts, October 2024 to September 2026. The monthly detail is in `05-monthly-financials.csv` and the customer-level MRR schedule in `04-customer-ledger.csv`. Gross profit excludes customer success and implementation costs, which are reported within operating expenses.

## 4. Definitions and footnotes
1. **ARR** is month-end MRR × 12 and includes (a) executed contracts with go-live scheduled within 90 days and (b) usage true-ups and one-time services billed in the month.
2. **Customers** means signed customers including those in implementation (16 at September 30).
3. **NRR and GRR** are calculated for enterprise accounts with ACV ≥ $150K at the start of the period (9 accounts); all other customers are excluded.
4. **Net burn** is total costs less revenue for the period indicated.
5. **Largest customer** is measured by billing entity, not by parent organization.
